## Visual Theme: DARK PROFESSIONAL PURPLE (GAMIFIED)

### Color Tokens
```python
# Copy these exactly into streamlit_app.py
BG_PRIMARY       = "#0E0B16"   # Page background — deep near-black purple
BG_CARD          = "#1A1530"   # Card / case file surface
BG_SIDEBAR       = "#130F23"   # Sidebar / command center
TEXT_PRIMARY     = "#E8E3F0"   # Primary text — soft off-white purple tint
TEXT_MUTED       = "#9B8FBE"   # Secondary / muted purple-grey
ACCENT           = "#A855F7"   # Vivid purple — buttons, highlights, borders
ACCENT_DARK      = "#7C3AED"   # Deeper purple — hover states

RISK_HIGH        = "#FF4B4B"   # HIGH severity — red
RISK_MEDIUM      = "#FFA500"   # MEDIUM severity — amber
RISK_LOW         = "#3FB950"   # LOW severity — green

PRIORITY_URGENT  = "#FF4B4B"   # IMMEDIATE ACTION badge
PRIORITY_REVIEW  = "#FFA500"   # INVESTIGATE badge
PRIORITY_MONITOR = "#3FB950"   # WATCH LIST badge

BADGE_URGENT_BG  = "#3D0000"   # URGENT badge background
BADGE_REVIEW_BG  = "#3D2200"   # REVIEW badge background
BADGE_MONITOR_BG = "#0D2B0D"   # MONITOR badge background
```

## Layout Structure: COD MW COMMAND CENTER

### Overall Structure (top to bottom)
```
[TOP NAV BAR — tabs]
[HERO SECTION — looping background video, full width]
[HUD STATS BANNER — 4 metric cards below video]
[ACTIVE CASE FILES — scrollable finding cards]
[THREAT INTELLIGENCE MAP — Plotly chart, full width]
```

### Top Navigation Bar
- App title left: `🛡 RISK SIGNAL AGGREGATOR`
- Subtitle: `AI-Powered Financial Threat Intelligence`
- Streamlit tabs: `[ 📁 UPLOAD ] [ 🔍 CASE FILES ] [ 📊 INTEL MAP ] [ ℹ ABOUT ]`
- Style: dark purple background, accent purple underline on active tab

### Sidebar — "⚙ COMMAND CENTER"
- Background: BG_SIDEBAR (#130F23)
- Header: `⚙ COMMAND CENTER` in ACCENT color, bold, uppercase
- Divider line in ACCENT color
- File uploader label: `📁 UPLOAD INTELLIGENCE FILE`
  - Accepts: CSV, JSON
  - Helper text: "Upload transaction dataset to begin threat analysis"
- Sample data button: `🎯 LOAD SAMPLE DATASET` (secondary style)
- Divider
- Run button: `▶ INITIATE ANALYSIS` — full width, ACCENT background, bold
- Post-run section header: `MISSION STATS`
  - Total findings with icon
  - Customers flagged
  - Highest threat score
  - Analysis timestamp
- Bottom: provider tag `Powered by Grok · Giovanni fallback`

### Hero Section — Background Video
- Full width, height: 320px
- Video: `app/assets/background.mp4` — autoplay, loop, muted, object-fit cover
- Overlay: linear gradient `rgba(14,11,22,0.55)` over the video
- Centered overlay text (shown before analysis runs):
  `"AWAITING INTELLIGENCE FILE..."` in muted purple, pulsing CSS animation
- After run: overlay text changes to `"THREAT ANALYSIS COMPLETE"` in green

### HUD Stats Banner (below video)
4 columns — each styled as a game stat card:
```
┌─────────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐
│  🎯 THREATS     │ │  👤 SUSPECTS    │ │  ⚡ CRITICAL    │ │  📡 SIGNALS     │
│  DETECTED       │ │  FLAGGED        │ │  ALERTS         │ │  IDENTIFIED     │
│                 │ │                 │ │                 │ │                 │
│      27         │ │       8         │ │      15         │ │      10         │
│  [████████░░]   │ │  [█████░░░░░]   │ │  [████████░░]   │ │  [███████░░░]   │
└─────────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └─────────────────┘
```
- Card background: BG_CARD with ACCENT border top (3px)
- Number: font-size 2.5rem, TEXT_PRIMARY, bold
- Label: TEXT_MUTED, uppercase, 11px
- Progress bar: HTML progress bar styled in ACCENT purple
  - Threats: value = total_findings / 50 * 100
  - Suspects: value = customers_flagged / 25 * 100
  - Critical: value = urgent_count / total_findings * 100
  - Signals: value = signal_type_count / 10 * 100

## Finding Cards: CLASSIFIED DOSSIER (GAMIFIED CASE FILES)

### Collapsed State (default)
```
┌─ CASE FILE #001 ─────────────────────────── ☠ CRITICAL ──────────────┐
│  James Okafor · STRUCTURING              [████████████████████] 90   │
│  ⚡ IMMEDIATE ACTION                                        [OPEN ▼] │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
- Left border: 4px solid — color = threat level color
- Background: BG_CARD
- Case number: TEXT_MUTED, small
- Customer name: TEXT_PRIMARY, bold
- Signal type: ACCENT color, uppercase
- Threat meter: HTML progress bar, color matches threat level
- Mission status badge: colored pill (MISSION_STATUS colors)

### Card Sort Order
- Default: sorted by risk_score descending (highest threat first)
- Filter pills above card list: [ ALL ] [ ☠ CRITICAL ] [ 🔴 THREAT ] [ 🟠 CAUTION ] [ 🟢 MONITOR ]

## Threat Intelligence Map (Plotly Chart)

- Title: `📡 THREAT INTELLIGENCE OVERVIEW`
- Type: Horizontal bar chart
- X-axis: count of findings per signal type
- Y-axis: signal type labels (formatted, not snake_case)
- Bar colors: mapped to severity (red/orange/green)
- Background: BG_PRIMARY (#0E0B16)
- Grid lines: subtle (#2A2040)
- Text: TEXT_PRIMARY
- Style: `plotly_dark` template with custom purple overrides
- Height: 400px

---

## Typography
- App title: font-size 1.8rem, font-weight 700, color TEXT_PRIMARY
- Section headers: font-size 1rem, font-weight 700, color ACCENT, uppercase, letter-spacing 2px
- Body / evidence: font-size 0.9rem, font-weight 400, color TEXT_PRIMARY
- Muted labels: font-size 0.75rem, color TEXT_MUTED, uppercase
- AI rationale: font-size 0.9rem, font-style italic, color TEXT_PRIMARY
- Risk badges: font-size 0.7rem, font-weight 600, uppercase, padding 2px 8px, border-radius 4px
- Case file number: font-size 0.7rem, color TEXT_MUTED, font-family monospace

## Spacing
- Card padding: 16px
- Section gap: 24px
- HUD banner gap: 16px between columns
- Card list gap: 12px between cards
- Left border on cards: 4px solid threat color

## Streamlit Custom CSS Block
```python
# Inject at top of streamlit_app.py with st.markdown(..., unsafe_allow_html=True)
CSS = """
<style>
/* Page background */
.stApp { background-color: #0E0B16; color: #E8E3F0; }

/* Sidebar */
[data-testid="stSidebar"] {
    background-color: #130F23;
    border-right: 1px solid #A855F7;
}

/* Hide default Streamlit header */
#MainMenu, footer, header { visibility: hidden; }

/* Buttons */
.stButton > button {
    background-color: #A855F7;
    color: #E8E3F0;
    border: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-radius: 4px;
    width: 100%;
}
.stButton > button:hover { background-color: #7C3AED; }

/* File uploader */
[data-testid="stFileUploader"] {
    background-color: #1A1530;
    border: 1px dashed #A855F7;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

/* Metric cards */
[data-testid="stMetric"] {
    background-color: #1A1530;
    border-top: 3px solid #A855F7;
    padding: 16px;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

/* Expanders (case files) */
[data-testid="stExpander"] {
    background-color: #1A1530;
    border-radius: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

/* Tabs */
.stTabs [data-baseweb="tab"] {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #9B8FBE;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.stTabs [aria-selected="true"] {
    color: #A855F7;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #A855F7;
}

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0E0B16; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #A855F7; border-radius: 3px; }

/* Progress bars (threat meters) */
.threat-meter {
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #2A2040;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 4px 0;
}
.threat-meter-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: width 0.6s ease;
}

/* Pulsing animation for awaiting state */
@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
    50% { opacity: 1; }
}
.awaiting-text { animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
</style>
"""
```

## Video Background Implementation
```python
# In streamlit_app.py — inject video as HTML
import base64

def get_video_html(video_path: str, overlay_text: str) -> str:
    with open(video_path, "rb") as f:
        video_bytes = f.read()
    video_b64 = base64.b64encode(video_bytes).decode()
    return f"""
    <div style="position:relative; width:100%; height:320px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:16px;">
        <video autoplay loop muted playsinline
               style="position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
                      min-width:100%; min-height:100%; object-fit:cover;">
            <source src="data:video/mp4;base64,{video_b64}" type="video/mp4">
        </video>
        <div style="position:absolute; inset:0;
                    background:linear-gradient(rgba(14,11,22,0.55), rgba(14,11,22,0.75));
                    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
            <p style="color:#9B8FBE; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:600;
                      letter-spacing:3px; text-transform:uppercase;"
               class="awaiting-text">{overlay_text}</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    """
```

## Component Checklist (poc-frontend must implement all)
- [ ] Page config: title="Risk Signal Aggregator", page_icon="🛡", layout="wide"
- [ ] CSS injection: full CSS block above at app start
- [ ] Sidebar: COMMAND CENTER header + file uploader + sample data button + run button + post-run stats
- [ ] Hero video: base64-encoded background.mp4 with overlay text (awaiting / complete)
- [ ] HUD banner: 4 st.columns — Threats / Suspects / Critical / Signals with threat meters
- [ ] Tab navigation: UPLOAD · CASE FILES · INTEL MAP · ABOUT
- [ ] Case file cards: st.expander per finding, left border color = threat level, collapsed default
- [ ] Card collapsed: case number + customer + signal + threat meter + mission status
- [ ] Card expanded: suspect profile + evidence briefing + AI field assessment + mission directive
- [ ] Filter pills above cards: ALL / CRITICAL / THREAT / CAUTION / MONITOR
- [ ] Threat Intelligence chart: Plotly horizontal bar, dark purple theme
- [ ] Error state: no file — show "UPLOAD INTELLIGENCE FILE TO BEGIN" in hero overlay
- [ ] Error state: API key missing — sidebar warning in red
- [ ] Error state: analysis fails — card shows "ANALYSIS UNAVAILABLE" with manual review note
- [ ] Error state: no findings — show "NO THREATS DETECTED" in green
- [ ] Sample data button loads financial_transactions.csv automatically
- [ ] All signal_type values displayed as formatted labels (not snake_case)
- [ ] Threat level badges use THREAT_LEVELS dict — not raw severity field
- [ ] Mission status uses MISSION_STATUS dict — not raw analyst_priority field
